select net.http_post( url:=$1, headers:=$2::jsonb, body:=concat($3, now(), $4)::jsonb ) as request_id

WITH pgrst_source AS (SELECT "pgrst_call".* FROM "public"."get_pending_escalations"() pgrst_call) SELECT $3::bigint AS total_result_set, pg_catalog.count(_postgrest_t) AS page_total, coalesce(json_agg(_postgrest_t), $4)

SELECT jobid, runid, status, start_time, end_time, EXTRACT($2 FROM (end_time - start_time))::numeric(10,2) AS seconds, left(return_message, $3) AS return_message FROM (SELECT *, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY jobid ORDE

SELECT e.name, n.nspname AS schema, e.default_version, x.extversion AS installed_version, e.comment, ev.schema AS default_version_schema FROM pg_available_extensions e LEFT JOIN pg_extension x ON e.name = x.extname LEFT
WITH rows AS ( SELECT ctid FROM net._http_response WHERE created < now() - $1 ORDER BY created LIMIT $2 ) DELETE FROM net._http_response r USING rows WHERE r.ctid = rows.ctid

WITH rows AS ( SELECT id FROM net.http_request_queue ORDER BY id LIMIT $1 ) DELETE FROM net.http_request_queue q USING rows WHERE q.id = rows.id RETURNING q.id, q.method, q.url, timeout_milliseconds, array(select key ||
select net.http_post( url := $1, headers := jsonb_build_object( $2,$3, $4, $5, $6,$7 || $8 ), body := jsonb_build_object($9, now()), timeout_milliseconds := $10 ) as request_id

SELECT e.extname AS name, e.extversion AS version, n.nspname AS schema, (SELECT default_version FROM pg_available_extensions a WHERE a.name = e.extname) AS available_version FROM pg_extension e JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.o

WITH pgrst_source AS (SELECT pgrst_call.pgrst_scalar FROM (SELECT $1 AS json_data) pgrst_payload, LATERAL (SELECT "p_contract_name", "p_contract_version", "p_deprecated" FROM json_to_record(pgrst_payload.json_data) AS _(
